error_message: Server trusts client-sent damage values — GameRoom.handleFire uses `const damage = input.damage || 25` allowing any client to send arbitrary damage
root_cause: Server reads damage value from client input without server-side validation or calculation; a malicious client can send damage=999999 or any value to one-shot other players
prevention_rule: PREVENT-LW-001: Never trust client-sent gameplay values (damage, position, health, speed) — server must authoritatively calculate all gameplay-critical values

error_message: No authentication — any client can connect to any game room without identity verification
root_cause: GameRoom accepts connections without token validation, session checks, or login flow; any WebSocket client can join and send inputs
prevention_rule: PREVENT-LW-002: Multiplayer server must require authentication token on WebSocket connection — reject unauthenticated connections

error_message: CORS wide open with origin: '*' — allows any website to connect to the game server
root_cause: Server CORS configuration uses wildcard origin allowing any web page to make requests to the server; combined with no auth this is a full security breach
prevention_rule: PREVENT-LW-003 / PREVENT-023: Never use CORS wildcard in multiplayer server — specify allowed origins explicitly

error_message: Matchmaking is in-memory array with no persistence — players lose match on server restart, no reconnect support
root_cause: Matchmaking queue stored as in-memory array on the server process; server restart wipes all active matches; no session persistence or reconnect mechanism
prevention_rule: PREVENT-LW-004: Matchmaking and room state must persist (Redis/database) — in-memory only is not acceptable for production multiplayer

error_message: Projectile physics use setTimeout(800ms) instead of real physics simulation — projectiles teleport after 800ms with no collision detection during flight
root_cause: Projectile lifetime and movement is simulated with setTimeout(800ms) — the projectile 'exists' for 800ms then resolves damage, with no per-frame physics step, no collision detection, no trajectory calculation
prevention_rule: PREVENT-LW-005: Projectile physics must use server-side game loop with per-frame collision detection — never setTimeout for physics resolution

error_message: No reconnection support — players who disconnect mid-match cannot rejoin and lose their position
root_cause: No session token, no reconnection handshake, no match ID persistence; disconnecting from a match is permanent
prevention_rule: PREVENT-LW-006: Multiplayer games must implement reconnection: session tokens, match ID persistence, grace period before removal
